question:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option from the given alternatives.

In today's digital age, convenience often comes at the cost of privacy. Every time a user browses a website, clicks a link, or uses an app, their data is collected-sometimes without their knowledge. Companies use this information to target ads, predict behavior, or even sell insights to third parties. While this can l

options.text: They are strict in all countries
They exist but are poorly enforced

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage states that some countries have introduced laws to protect user data.
 
• However, it also clearly mentions that **implementation remains weak**, showing that these laws exist but are not strictly enforced.
 
• Hence, the correct interpretation is that laws are present, but enforcement is poor.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3 – They exist but are poorly enforced.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other options are incorrect:
 
 
• Option 1 (strong and global) – Not mentioned in the passage.
 
• Option 2 (strict in all countries) – Contradicts the passage.
 
• Option 4 (unnecessary) – Passage never suggests this.
